sections.Profile:
The "Whoopee" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Mfg. Co. in October 1964, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek. This machine features two flippers, four jet bumpers, one passive bumper, three rollover buttons, and two kickers.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Carnival, Circus, Original Theme, Amusement, Playfield Gimmick, Single level playfield
